notes: 4 [But] he shall not defile himself, [being] a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

The Lord's instruction that a priest should "take a wife" was later taught by Paul to include elders and bishops. (Titus 1:5-7.) Evidently the Lord has never required celibacy as a prerequisite to receiving the priesthood. (Daniel H. Ludlow, A Companion to Your Study of the Old Testament, 170.) Leviticus 21:14
14 A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, [or] an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
